android.desc:
Score points by predicting the outcomes of World Cup football matches. Invite you friends and keep track of their scores.


You can get a score boost by using a "Super Badge". Super badges give you +5 points for correct predictions and -2 points if you are wrong.




**Explanation for Permissions**:
Location - We use your approximate location to customise the app for you.
Wake Lock - This is a requirement for using Google's notification service. The app itself does not wake the device. We have been very careful to keep battery consumption at a bare minimum.


Privacy Policy:
http://dipoletech.com/predictor/privacy.html
